params.caption: 🖥️ Cheaper OLED monitors could arrive sooner than expected TCL CSOT says its new inkjet-printing OLED plant could be running as soon as late 2027. Earlier rumours had pointed to 2028. Inkjet printing is seen as a way to make OLED panels cheaper, which could bring down prices of OLED gaming monitors. 🕒 Nov 9, 2026 · 19:58 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer #OLED #PCHardware #GamingNews
